kinds.summary_zh: 一组或多组连续变量的折线图，支持误差带、标记点与平滑。
kinds.summary_en: One or more continuous series with error bands, markers and smoothing.

kinds.summary_zh: 强调多条曲线的可区分性：自动轮换标记与线型，可选对数纵轴。
kinds.summary_en: Distinguishable multi-series lines with cycling markers and line styles, optional log y.

kinds.summary_zh: 离散事件或状态变化的阶梯曲线，可指定台阶对齐方式。
kinds.summary_en: Step curve for discrete events or state changes with configurable alignment.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组散点图，可叠加回归线与 95% 置信带，并标注相关统计量。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped scatter with optional regression line, 95% CI band and correlation statistics.

kinds.summary_zh: 用点面积编码第三个变量，附尺寸图例。
kinds.summary_en: Encode a third variable with marker area, with a size legend.

kinds.summary_zh: 单序列柱状图，支持误差棒、数值标签与自动旋转的类别标签。
kinds.summary_en: Single-series bars with error bars, value labels and automatic category rotation.

kinds.summary_zh: 按组并列的柱状图，用于多条件比较，支持误差棒与图例。
kinds.summary_en: Side-by-side grouped bars for multi-condition comparisons with error bars and legend.

kinds.summary_zh: 堆叠或百分比堆叠柱状图，适合组成与占比比较。
kinds.summary_en: Stacked or 100% stacked bars for composition and share comparisons.

kinds.summary_zh: 横向条形图，类别名较长时更清晰，可选排序。
kinds.summary_en: Horizontal bars that stay readable with long category names, with optional sorting.

kinds.summary_zh: 低墨量的条形替代方案，适合排序后的类别比较。
kinds.summary_en: A low-ink alternative to bars for ranked category comparisons.

kinds.summary_zh: 均值±误差的散点/连线图，支持双向误差棒与对数坐标。
kinds.summary_en: Mean +/- error points and lines with bidirectional error bars and log scales.

kinds.summary_zh: 以填充面积强调量级的曲线，可叠加误差带。
kinds.summary_en: Filled-area curves that emphasise magnitude, with optional error bands.

kinds.summary_zh: 展示多个组成部分随时间变化的累计贡献。
kinds.summary_en: Cumulative contribution of several components over a shared x.

kinds.summary_zh: 单一时间点的组成占比，可选环形与百分比标注；多类别时优先考虑条形图。
kinds.summary_en: Composition at a single time point, optional donut and percentage labels; prefer bars for many categories.

kinds.summary_zh: 单组或多组分布直方图，共享分箱范围，可切换概率密度与计数。
kinds.summary_en: One or several distributions sharing bin ranges, as probability density or counts.

kinds.summary_zh: 双变量联合分布的热图，可对频数取对数以兼顾稀疏区。
kinds.summary_en: Joint distribution heat map of two variables, with optional log counts.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组分布箱线：中位线、四分位箱、1.5 IQR 须与离群点，组名下方标注样本量。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped box plots with median, IQR box, 1.5-IQR whiskers, outliers and per-group n.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组核密度轮廓叠加内嵌箱线，兼顾完整分布形状与四分位摘要。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped KDE silhouettes with an embedded box plot for shape plus quartile summary.

kinds.summary_zh: 半小提琴（云）+ 箱线 + 抖动散点（雨）三件套，同组三要素严格对齐。
kinds.summary_en: Half violin (cloud), box and jittered points (rain) aligned per group.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组抖动散点加中央趋势横线，逐点展示样本量与离散程度。
kinds.summary_en: Jittered points per group with a central-tendency bar and per-group n.

kinds.summary_zh: 按组垂直偏移的半透明密度曲线，组标签在左侧，适合多组分布并列比较。
kinds.summary_en: Vertically offset semi-transparent densities with left-hand group labels.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组核密度曲线，填充与描边叠加，组间峰位差异一目了然。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped KDE curves with matching fill and outline for direct peak comparison.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组经验累积分布阶梯曲线，可读写任意分位点上的组间差距。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped empirical CDF steps for reading group gaps at any quantile.

kinds.summary_zh: 标准化样本分位数对理论正态分位数，含 1:1 参考线、95% 点态包络与 Shapiro–Wilk 检验。
kinds.summary_en: Standardised sample vs theoretical normal quantiles with 1:1 line, 95% envelope and Shapiro–Wilk test.

kinds.summary_zh: 变量两两 Pearson/Spearman 相关矩阵：发散色标以 0 居中、格内两位小数、可选下三角。
kinds.summary_en: Pairwise Pearson/Spearman matrix with a zero-centred diverging scale, two-decimal cells and optional lower triangle.

kinds.summary_zh: 多变量两两散点矩阵：对角线核密度、下三角散点与拟合线、格内相关系数与仅外圈轴标签。
kinds.summary_en: Scatter matrix with diagonal KDEs, lower-triangle fits and pairwise r, labels on the outer ring only.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组散点 + 最小二乘拟合线 + 95% 置信带，角落注释方程、R² 与 p 值。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped scatter with OLS lines, 95% CI bands and an equation/R²/p note.

kinds.summary_zh: 残差对拟合值散点（含 y=0 参考线）与可选 Q–Q 子图，用于线性模型假设检查。
kinds.summary_en: Residual-vs-fitted scatter with a y=0 reference line plus an optional Q–Q subplot.

kinds.summary_zh: 五级（或任意奇数级）同意度发散堆叠条：中性段居中于 0、组件图例、百分比轴。
kinds.summary_en: Diverging stacked Likert bars with a zero-centred neutral segment, legend and percentage axis.

kinds.summary_zh: 差异表达火山图：log2 倍数变化与 -log10 P 定位显著基因，阈值线、三组配色与 top 基因标注。
kinds.summary_en: Differential-expression volcano: log2 fold change vs -log10 p with thresholds, three groups and top-gene labels.

kinds.summary_zh: 以平均表达强度为横轴、log2 倍数变化为纵轴的 MA 图，含阈值线与上/下调配色。
kinds.summary_en: Mean-expression versus log2 fold-change MA plot with thresholds and up/down colours.

kinds.summary_zh: GWAS 曼哈顿图：染色体交替双色、全基因组显著性阈值、top 位点标注与稀疏染色体刻度。
kinds.summary_en: GWAS Manhattan plot with alternating chromosome colours, genome-wide threshold, lead-SNP labels and sparse chromosome ticks.

kinds.summary_zh: 阶梯生存曲线、删失刻度、log-rank P，主图下方附对齐的风险人数表。
kinds.summary_en: Step survival curves with censor ticks, log-rank P and an aligned number-at-risk table underneath.

kinds.summary_zh: meta 分析森林图：点估计 + 95% CI、权重映射方块大小、无效线、右侧数值列与合并菱形。
kinds.summary_en: Meta-analysis forest plot with point estimates, 95% CI, weight-sized squares, null line, estimate column and pooled diamond.

kinds.summary_zh: 诊断性能 ROC：对角线基准、阶梯曲线、AUC 图例，支持原始评分+结局或预算 FPR/TPR。
kinds.summary_en: Diagnostic ROC with chance diagonal, step curves and AUC legend; accepts raw scores+outcomes or precomputed FPR/TPR.

kinds.summary_zh: PR 曲线：预算曲线或原始评分计算，阳性率基线虚线、平均精度（AP）图例、最佳 F1 工作点。
kinds.summary_en: Precision-recall curves from scores or precomputed values with prevalence baseline, AP legend and best-F1 operating point.

kinds.summary_zh: 预测概率 vs 观察比例：理想线 y=x、分组折线与误差棒，评估模型校准度。
kinds.summary_en: Predicted probability versus observed proportion with identity line, per-group curves and error bars.

kinds.summary_zh: 两种测量方法的一致性：均值差横线、±1.96 SD 界限、散点与统计注释。
kinds.summary_en: Method-agreement plot with bias line, 95% limits of agreement, scatter and summary note.

labels.x: Mean of NGS and ctDNA VAF

kinds.summary_zh: 对数浓度轴、实测点与 4PL 拟合曲线、95% 置信带、EC50 虚线与标注，SciPy 不可用时 NumPy 降级拟合。
kinds.summary_en: Log-concentration axis with measured points, 4PL curve, 95% band and EC50 annotation; NumPy fallback when SciPy is absent.

kinds.summary_zh: 行列层次聚类热图：双向树状图、可选行 z-score、0 居中发散色标、色标与行列标签。
kinds.summary_en: Clustered heatmap with row/column dendrograms, optional row z-score, zero-centred diverging map and labels.

kinds.summary_zh: 分组 PCA 散点：95% 置信椭圆、质心与轴解释方差百分比，自动从数值特征列计算主成分。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped PCA scores with 95% confidence ellipses, centroids and explained-variance axis labels.

kinds.summary_zh: 二维 t-SNE 嵌入分组散点，图例标注细胞谱系，点大小可调。
kinds.summary_en: Two-dimensional t-SNE embedding coloured by cluster with legend and adjustable point size.

kinds.summary_zh: 基因 × 簇点图：点大小为阳性比例、颜色为平均表达，附色标与尺寸图例。
kinds.summary_en: Gene-by-cluster dot plot with detection fraction as size and mean expression as colour, plus colorbar and size legend.

kinds.summary_zh: 按富集分数排序的横向棒图，正负效应双色、通路标签与 BH-FDR 显著性星标。
kinds.summary_en: Horizontally ranked enrichment-score bars coloured by direction with pathway labels and BH-FDR stars.

kinds.summary_zh: 多曲线叠加的振动光谱（FTIR/Raman/UV-Vis）：逐条归一化、垂直偏移、峰位标注与反向波数轴。
kinds.summary_en: Overlaid vibrational spectra with per-trace normalisation, vertical offsets, peak labels and a reversed wavenumber axis.

kinds.summary_zh: 按样品垂直堆叠的粉末 XRD：2θ 轴、特征峰位标注与可选参考卡片竖线。
kinds.summary_en: Powder XRD patterns stacked per sample with a 2-theta axis, characteristic-peak labels and optional reference sticks.

kinds.summary_zh: 闭合 CV 回线：多圈叠加、扫描方向箭头、氧化/还原峰位标注与电位-电流轴。
kinds.summary_en: Closed cyclic-voltammetry loops with multiple cycles, scan-direction arrows and anodic/cathodic peak labels.

kinds.summary_zh: 双 y 轴热分析：左轴失重百分比、右轴热流，温度轴与分解温度/拐点标注，两轴颜色区分。
kinds.summary_en: Dual-axis thermal analysis: weight loss on the left, heat flow on the right, with decomposition temperatures and colour-matched axes.

kinds.summary_zh: 二维标量的填充等高线：等高线标注、感知均匀色标与物理量标签。
kinds.summary_en: Filled contours of a 2-D scalar field with inline level labels and a labelled, perceptually uniform colour bar.

kinds.summary_zh: 矩阵或二维长表热图：pcolormesh/imshow、色标物理量标签，小矩阵可选逐格数值标注。
kinds.summary_en: Matrix or long-form heatmap with a labelled colour bar and optional in-cell values for small matrices.

kinds.summary_zh: 带色标的 3-D 曲面：可调视角、块状长宽比、白底面板与感知均匀色标（避免彩虹色）。
kinds.summary_en: 3-D surface with a colour bar, adjustable view, sensible box aspect and a perceptually uniform map (no rainbow).

kinds.summary_zh: 3-D 分组散点：分组配色与图例、白底面板、可调视角，适合三变量结构-性能关系。
kinds.summary_en: Grouped 3-D scatter with group colours, a legend, white panes and an adjustable view for three-variable structure-property relations.

kinds.summary_zh: 极坐标方向图：角度刻度（45° 间隔）、径向 dB 刻度与多平面曲线，适合天线/散射方向图。
kinds.summary_en: Polar pattern with 45-degree azimuth ticks, radial dB grid and multiple planes for antenna or scattering patterns.

kinds.summary_zh: 16 方位风向频率堆叠极坐标柱：风速分级、北向 0°、顺时针方位、径向频率刻度与顺序色标。
kinds.summary_en: 16-sector stacked polar wind rose: speed classes, north-up 0-degree clockwise azimuth, radial frequency ticks and a sequential colour ramp.

kinds.summary_zh: Quarter-circle Taylor 图：相关角射线、RMSD 同心圆、参考点与模型点标注。
kinds.summary_en: Quarter-circle Taylor diagram with correlation rays, RMSD circles centred on the reference and labelled model points.

kinds.summary_zh: 上下双面板幅频（dB）与相频（deg）图：共享对数频率轴、浅色网格，可选增益穿越频率与相位裕度标注。
kinds.summary_en: Magnitude (dB) and phase (deg) panels sharing a log frequency axis with a light grid and optional gain-crossover / phase-margin annotation.

kinds.summary_zh: 复阻抗 Nyquist 图：等比例坐标轴、测量点标记、沿曲线递增频率箭头，适合电化学阻抗谱。
kinds.summary_en: Complex-impedance Nyquist plot with equal-aspect axes, measured-point markers and along-curve frequency arrows.

kinds.summary_zh: log-log 功率谱密度：1/f 参考斜率、噪声基底虚线与工频峰，适合噪声与振动分析。
kinds.summary_en: Log-log PSD with a 1/f reference slope, a dashed noise floor and mains peaks for noise and vibration analysis.

kinds.summary_zh: 多通道示波器波形：逐通道垂直偏移、左端通道标签、稀疏时间刻度，适合信号对比。
kinds.summary_en: Oscilloscope-style stacked channels with vertical offsets, left-edge channel labels and sparse time ticks.

kinds.summary_zh: 降序柱 + 累计贡献折线：右侧百分比轴、80% 参考线与关键少数类别注释。
kinds.summary_en: Descending bars with a cumulative-contribution line, a right percentage axis, an 80% reference and a key-few annotation.

kinds.summary_zh: X̄ 控制图：数据点 + 中心线 + UCL/LCL 虚线，超限点高亮并标注样本编号，适合 SPC 过程监控。
kinds.summary_en: X-bar control chart with centre line, dashed UCL/LCL limits and highlighted out-of-control points labelled by sample.

kinds.summary_zh: 折线 + 置信带：mapping y_lower/y_upper 给出不对称区间，可选零线参考与末点数值标注。
kinds.summary_en: Line chart with a confidence band from mapping y_lower/y_upper, an optional reference line and an end-value label.

kinds.summary_zh: 多层置信带预测扇形图：50/80/95% 区间逐层加深、中位线实虚线区分历史与预测、预测起点竖线。
kinds.summary_en: Forecast fan chart with nested 50/80/95% bands, a median line that switches from solid history to dashed forecast and a forecast-origin rule.

kinds.summary_zh: 累计桥接瀑布图：增量柱首尾相连、正负配色、阶段标签与可选合计柱，适合利润桥与预算分解。
kinds.summary_en: Cumulative bridge waterfall with connected deltas, signed colours, stage labels and an optional total bar for profit bridges and budget walks.

kinds.summary_zh: 双向水平条敏感性图：按影响幅度排序、正负配色、中心零线，适合 NPV / 估值假设敏感性。
kinds.summary_en: Two-sided horizontal sensitivity bars sorted by swing, with signed colours and a zero centre line for NPV or valuation assumptions.

kinds.name_zh: 漏斗图（率 vs 样本量）
kinds.summary_zh: 转化率–样本量漏斗图：合并期望率水平线、±2 SE 置信边界、显著偏离渠道高亮标注，适合渠道与 A/B 分析。
kinds.summary_en: Conversion-rate funnel against sample size with a pooled expectation, +/-2 SE limits and labelled outlying channels for channel and A/B analysis.

kinds.summary_zh: 多随机种子训练/验证曲线：均值实线 + ±1 SD 阴影，可对数纵轴，图例区分数据划分。
kinds.summary_en: Multi-seed train/validation curves: mean line with +/-1 SD band and an optional log y axis.

kinds.summary_zh: 分类混淆矩阵热图：行列类别标签、格内数值（按底色自动黑/白字）、色标与行归一化选项。
kinds.summary_en: Confusion-matrix heat map with class labels, contrast-aware cell values, colour bar and row normalisation.

kinds.summary_zh: 排序横向棒图：点估计 + 95% 置信区间误差棒 + 数值标签，突出最有信息量的特征。
kinds.summary_en: Sorted horizontal importance bars with 95% CI error bars and value labels.

kinds.summary_zh: 降维/潜在空间二维嵌入：按类别着色散点、图例、轴标签与样本量注释（如 t-SNE 1/2）。
kinds.summary_en: Two-dimensional latent-space embedding coloured by class with legend, axis labels and n.

kinds.summary_zh: 按 ncols 网格排布 A/B/C 子图：每格可选 line / scatter / bar / box / heatmap，自带粗体面板编号与独立标签。
kinds.summary_en: Grid of lettered panels built from line/scatter/bar/box/heatmap specs with per-panel data, labels and bold panel letters.

domains.description_zh: 中性、克制的默认风格，适用于交叉学科与快速出图。
domains.description_en: Neutral, restrained default for interdisciplinary or quick figures.

domains.description_zh: 开放式坐标轴、细线小标记、色盲友好配色，贴近 Nature/Cell 生命科学图版。
domains.description_en: Open axes, fine lines, small markers and CVD-safe colours, close to Nature/Cell life-science figures.

domains.description_zh: NEJM/Lancet 式临床图：清晰的时间-事件曲线、森林图与校准曲线，字号偏大易读。
domains.description_en: NEJM/Lancet-style clinical figures: legible survival, forest and calibration plots.

domains.description_zh: 高通量数据：火山图、聚类热图、降维散点，感知均匀色标与紧凑标注。
domains.description_en: High-throughput data: volcano, clustered heatmaps, embeddings, perceptually uniform maps.

domains.description_zh: ACS/RSC 风格：闭合坐标框、内向刻度、柔和配色，适配光谱、伏安与热分析曲线。
domains.description_en: ACS/RSC feel: boxed axes, inward ticks, muted palette for spectra, voltammetry and thermal analysis.

domains.description_zh: 材料物理风格：完整边框、主次刻度、相位图与 3D 表面，突出结构-性能关系。
domains.description_en: Materials-physics style: full frame, major/minor ticks, phase maps and 3D surfaces.

domains.description_zh: APS/PRL 风格：Times 字体、内向主次刻度、闭合边框，强调误差棒与解析曲线。
domains.description_en: APS/PRL style: Times text, inward major/minor ticks, boxed frame, error bars and theory curves.

domains.description_zh: IEEE 工程风格：浅色网格、闭合边框、内向刻度，适配 Bode/Nyquist/PSD 与波形图。
domains.description_en: IEEE engineering style: light grid, boxed frame, inward ticks for Bode/Nyquist/PSD and waveforms.

domains.description_zh: AGU 风格：坐标框、方向性网格、大地色系，适配等值线、风玫瑰与时间序列。
domains.description_en: AGU style: framed axes, directional grid, earth tones for contours, wind roses and time series.

domains.description_zh: AER 风格：Times、仅横向参考线、开放式坐标轴，适配时间序列、扇形图与瀑布图。
domains.description_en: AER style: Times, horizontal reference lines, open axes for time series, fan charts and waterfalls.

domains.description_zh: APA 风格：无网格、低饱和配色、清晰组间对比，适配分组柱、箱线与相关矩阵。
domains.description_en: APA style: no grid, low-saturation colours, clear group contrasts for grouped bars, boxes and correlations.

domains.description_zh: NeurIPS 风格：清爽网格、稍粗曲线与较大标记，适配训练曲线、混淆矩阵与降维图。
domains.description_en: NeurIPS style: light grid, slightly heavier curves and markers for training curves, confusion matrices and embeddings.

domains.description_zh: 极简数学排版：Times/STIX 公式、闭合边框、克制留白，适配分布、QQ 与收敛曲线。
domains.description_en: Minimal mathematical typesetting: Times/STIX math, boxed frame, restrained whitespace for distributions, QQ and convergence.

journals.note_en: 86 mm single / 178 mm double, 7–8 pt, clinical legibility first.

journals.note_en: 90 mm single / 190 mm double, pragmatic clinical layout.

journals.note_en: 86 mm single / 178 mm double, 7 pt and up, terse graphic language.

3.5 in（88.9 mm）/ 7.16 in（181 mm），8 pt Times，内向刻度。

journals.note_en: 86 mm single / 178 mm double, 8 pt Times, major+minor ticks.

categorical.source: ggsci NPG palette (Nature Publishing Group figures)

samples.description_zh: 五种处理下的相对细胞活力与 SEM，适合柱状、条形、误差棒与棒棒糖图。
samples.description_en: Relative viability for five treatments with SEM, for bars, horizontal bars, error bars and lollipops.

samples.description_zh: 五种处理的相对细胞活力，按性别分组并提供 SEM。
samples.description_en: Relative viability for five treatments split by sex with SEM.

samples.description_zh: 肿瘤组织 NGS 与 ctDNA 检测的变异等位基因频率配对测量（n=128）。
samples.description_en: Paired variant-allele fractions from tumour NGS and ctDNA assays (n=128).

samples.description_zh: 开发队列与验证队列的预测概率、观察比例与标准误（分箱，n=320/210）。
samples.description_en: Predicted probabilities, observed proportions and standard errors for development and validation cohorts.

samples.description_zh: 两种化合物 12 个对数浓度梯度下的细胞活力（每浓度 3 复孔，%）用于 4PL 拟合。
samples.description_en: Viability for two compounds across 12 log-spaced concentrations (triplicates, %) for 4PL fitting.

samples.description_zh: 8 项免疫联合治疗研究的 PFS 风险比、95% CI 与权重，附合并效应行。
samples.description_en: PFS hazard ratios, 95% CI and weights for eight immuno-oncology studies plus a pooled row.

samples.description_zh: 650 个基因的平均表达强度与 log2 倍数变化，用于 MA 图。
samples.description_en: Mean expression versus log2 fold change for 650 genes (MA plot).

samples.description_zh: 22 条常染色体上约 1500 个 SNP 的 -log10 P，含 3 个显著信号峰。
samples.description_en: About 1,500 SNPs across 22 autosomes with three genome-wide significant peaks.

samples.description_zh: 三个风险模型的连续评分与 12 个月复发结局（阳性率约 30%），用于 PR 曲线。
samples.description_en: Continuous risk scores and 12-month recurrence labels (~30% prevalence) for three models.

samples.description_zh: 临床模型、ctDNA 模型与联合模型预测 12 个月复发的 ROC 曲线。
samples.description_en: ROC curves for clinical, ctDNA and combined models predicting 12-month recurrence.

samples.description_zh: 两组晚期肿瘤患者的随访时间与事件状态（n=112/组，随机删失）。
samples.description_en: Follow-up time and event status for two advanced-cancer arms (n=112 each, random censoring).

samples.description_zh: 模拟 900 个基因的 log2 倍数变化与 -log10 P，含 20 个显著上调/下调标记基因。
samples.description_en: Simulated log2 fold change and -log10 P for 900 genes with 20 curated up/down markers.

samples.description_zh: 年龄、BMI、血糖、胰岛素与 CRP 的相关结构，适合相关矩阵与散点矩阵。
samples.description_en: Correlation structure of age, BMI, glucose, insulin and CRP for correlograms and pair plots.

samples.description_zh: 四组样本的效应量分布，适合箱线、小提琴、雨云与密度图。
samples.description_en: Effect-size distributions for four cohorts; good for box, violin, raincloud and density.

samples.description_zh: 24 个月历史 + 24 个月预测的 CPI 通胀，含 50/80/95% 区间，适合分层置信带扇形图。
samples.description_en: 24 months of history and 24 months of CPI-inflation forecast with 50/80/95% intervals for a layered fan chart.

samples.name_zh: 渠道转化率漏斗图（率 vs 样本量）
samples.name_en: Channel conversion funnel (rate vs sample size)
samples.description_zh: 10 个获客渠道的转化率与样本量，含合并期望线与 ±2 SE 置信区间；小样本渠道偏离显著。
samples.description_en: Conversion rate against sample size for ten acquisition channels with a pooled expectation and +/-2 SE limits; small channels deviate significantly.

samples.name_zh: GDP 增速时间序列与 95% 置信带
samples.name_en: GDP growth time series with 95% band
samples.description_zh: 60 个月的 GDP 同比增速与置信区间，含一次衰退冲击，适合折线 + 置信带。
samples.description_en: 60 months of year-on-year GDP growth with a confidence band and one recession shock for line-plus-band time series.

samples.description_zh: 7 项假设对项目 NPV 的低/高情形影响（USD 百万），适合双向水平条与排序。
samples.description_en: Low/high NPV impacts of seven assumptions (USD millions) for sorted two-sided horizontal bars.

samples.description_zh: 从收入到净利润的 7 阶段利润桥（USD 百万），适合累计连接与正负配色。
samples.description_en: A seven-stage profit bridge from revenue to net income in USD millions for cumulative connectors and signed colours.

samples.description_zh: ζ = 0.3、ω$_n$ = 1 kHz 的二阶低通频响（0.1 Hz–1 MHz），含谐振峰与 −90° 相位过渡。
samples.description_en: Frequency response of a second-order low-pass (zeta = 0.3, fn = 1 kHz) from 0.1 Hz to 1 MHz with resonance and -90 deg phase transition.

samples.name_zh: X̄ 控制图（3 个失控点）
samples.name_en: X-bar control chart with out-of-control points
samples.description_zh: 60 个样本的均值控制图（CL 50.0、UCL/LCL ±3σ），含 3 个超限点，适合中心线与超限高亮。
samples.description_en: A 60-sample X-bar chart (CL 50.0, +/-3 sigma limits) with three out-of-control points for centre-line and violation highlighting.

samples.name_zh: 电化学阻抗 Nyquist 谱
samples.description_zh: Randles 型阻抗谱（R$_s$ = 10 Ω、R$_{ct}$ = 200 Ω、CPE α = 0.82），适合等比例坐标与频率方向标注。
samples.description_en: Randles-type impedance spectrum (Rs = 10 ohm, Rct = 200 ohm, CPE alpha = 0.82) for equal-aspect Nyquist plots with frequency direction.

samples.description_zh: 8 类焊点缺陷计数（n = 476），降序柱 + 累计百分比，前 4 类约占 79%。
samples.description_en: Counts of eight solder-defect classes (n = 476) for descending bars with a cumulative-percentage line; the top four account for about 79%.

samples.description_zh: 0.1–1000 Hz 的 PSD（f$^{-0.9}$ 漂移 + 50 Hz 工频及其谐波），适合 log-log 曲线与噪声基底标注。
samples.description_en: PSD from 0.1 to 1000 Hz with 1/f^0.9 drift, a 50 Hz mains line and its harmonic, for log-log plots with a noise floor.

samples.description_zh: 10 ms 内的三条通道（50 Hz、120 Hz + 瞬态、25 Hz 方波），适合多通道偏移波形与通道标签。
samples.description_en: Three channels over 10 ms (50 Hz, 120 Hz with a transient, 25 Hz square wave) for offset multi-channel waveforms.

samples.description_zh: 三种条件在 48 h 内的光密度生长曲线，适合折线/面积/回归类图。
samples.description_en: OD600 growth over 48 h under three conditions; good for line, area and regression charts.

samples.description_zh: 8×8 基因×样本 z-score 长表，适合热图与聚类热图。
samples.description_en: 8x8 gene-by-sample z-score table in long form for heatmaps and clustered heatmaps.

samples.description_zh: 组织病理四分类模型在 800 例测试集上的混淆计数（行=真实，列=预测）。
samples.description_en: Confusion counts of a four-class histopathology model on 800 test cases (rows = truth).

samples.description_zh: 四类组织病理切片的 t-SNE 潜在空间嵌入，类别间存在真实重叠。
samples.description_en: t-SNE embedding of four histopathology classes with realistic class overlap.

samples.description_zh: 10 个病理特征的置换重要性及 95% bootstrap 置信区间。
samples.description_en: Permutation importance of ten pathology features with 95% bootstrap intervals.

samples.description_zh: 5 个随机种子的训练/验证交叉熵损失，含轻微过拟合转折。
samples.description_en: Train/validation cross-entropy for five random seeds with a mild overfitting turnover.

samples.name_zh: 标志基因点图（表达比例 × 平均表达）
samples.name_en: Dot plot of marker genes (fraction x mean expression)
samples.description_zh: 12 个标志基因在 6 个细胞簇中的阳性比例与平均表达，用于双编码点图。
samples.description_en: Detection fraction and mean expression of 12 marker genes across six cell clusters.

samples.name_zh: 单细胞标志基因表达矩阵
samples.description_zh: 26 个免疫/基质/上皮/增殖标志基因在 12 个样本中的表达（长表），行聚类结构明显。
samples.description_en: Expression of 26 immune/stromal/epithelial/proliferation markers across 12 samples (long form) with clear row clusters.

samples.name_zh: GSEA 通路富集棒图数据
samples.description_zh: 12 条 Hallmark 通路的标准化富集分数与 P 值（免疫治疗应答 vs 无应答）。
samples.description_en: Normalised enrichment scores and P values for 12 Hallmark pathways (responders vs non-responders).

samples.description_zh: 三组受试者（健康/应答/无应答）的 8 维表达特征（n=150），用于主成分分析。
samples.description_en: Eight-dimensional expression features for three groups (healthy/responder/non-responder, n=150) for PCA.

samples.description_zh: 220 个细胞的 t-SNE 二维嵌入与四个细胞谱系标签。
samples.description_en: Two-dimensional t-SNE embedding of 220 cells with four lineage labels.

samples.name_zh: 二维势能面 / 场分布
samples.description_zh: 51×33 的二维能量场（eV），适合填充等高线、色标与 3D 曲面。
samples.description_en: A 51x33 two-dimensional energy field (eV) for filled contours, colour bars and 3-D surfaces.

samples.description_zh: 可逆氧化还原对的 3 圈 CV（0–1.2 V），含电容基线与峰位偏移，适合回线与扫描方向标注。
samples.description_en: Three-cycle CV of a quasi-reversible redox couple (0-1.2 V) with capacitive baseline, for loop and scan-direction annotation.

samples.description_zh: 10×8 微区相分数矩阵（0–1），适合 pcolormesh/imshow 热图、色标与数值标注。
samples.description_en: A 10x8 phase-fraction map (0-1) for pcolormesh/imshow heatmaps with colour bar and cell values.

samples.description_zh: E 面与 H 面归一化增益（0–360°，主瓣 0°、后瓣与副瓣），适合极坐标曲线与方向刻度。
samples.description_en: Normalized E-plane and H-plane gain over 0-360 deg with a broadside main lobe for polar plots and azimuth ticks.

samples.name_zh: 3D 分组散点：粒径–电位–摄取率
samples.description_zh: 3 组纳米颗粒的粒径（nm）、Zeta 电位（mV）与摄取速率（h$^{-1}$），适合 3D 分组散点。
samples.description_en: Three groups of nanoparticles with size (nm), zeta potential (mV) and uptake rate (1/h) for 3-D grouped scatters.

samples.description_zh: PMMA / PS / PVA 三片薄膜的 FTIR 吸收谱（4000–400 cm$^{-1}$），适合多曲线叠加与峰位标注。
samples.description_en: FTIR absorbance of PMMA / PS / PVA films, 4000-400 cm-1, for overlaid spectra with peak labels.

samples.name_zh: Taylor 图：模式-观测一致性
samples.description_zh: 5 个化学传输模式相对观测的相关系数与归一化标准差（参考标准差 = 1），适合 Taylor 图。
samples.description_en: Correlation and normalized standard deviation of five chemistry-transport models against observations (reference sigma = 1) for Taylor diagrams.

samples.description_zh: 30–900 °C 的失重曲线与热流曲线（吸热峰），适合双 y 轴与分解温度标注。
samples.description_en: Weight-loss and heat-flow curves from 30 to 900 C for dual-axis thermal analysis with decomposition temperatures.

samples.name_zh: 风向–风速观测（16 方位）
samples.description_zh: 640 条地面风观测（方位 0–360°、风速 m s$^{-1}$），适合风玫瑰与极坐标频率统计。
samples.description_en: 640 surface wind observations (azimuth 0-360 deg, speed m/s) for wind roses and directional statistics.

samples.description_zh: 锐钛矿、金红石与混相 TiO$_2$ 的粉末 XRD（2θ = 20–80°），适合堆叠谱线与特征峰标注。
samples.description_en: Anatase, rutile and mixed-phase TiO2 powder XRD (2-theta 20-80 deg) for stacked patterns with peak labels.

samples.description_zh: 三种组织的基因表达与蛋白丰度，含细胞数可用于气泡大小。
samples.description_en: Gene expression vs protein abundance across three tissues, with cell counts for bubble size.

samples.description_zh: 基因表达与蛋白丰度的相关双变量样本，适合二维直方图与密度图。
samples.description_en: Correlated gene-expression and protein-abundance draws for 2D histograms and density maps.

samples.description_zh: 临床医生对 AI 辅助诊断的六条态度陈述，五级同意度计数（每行 n = 512）。
samples.description_en: Six clinician attitude items on AI-assisted diagnosis with five agreement levels (n = 512 per item).

samples.description_zh: 对照组近似正态、处理组右偏的两个样本，适合 Q–Q 图与正态性检验。
samples.description_en: One near-normal control and one right-skewed treatment sample for Q-Q plots and normality tests.

samples.name_zh: 增长与置信区间时间序列
samples.description_zh: 60 个月的增长率及置信带，适合时间序列、置信带、扇形图。
samples.description_en: 60 months of growth with confidence bands for time-series, band and fan charts.

quickstart.zh: 先调用能力清单选择 kind 与 domain/journal 预设，再用 data.sample 或表格数据出图；可选矢量导出。
quickstart.en: Pick a kind and a domain/journal preset from capabilities, render from data.sample or tabular rows, export vector formats optionally.
